description: This file is a JavaScript implementation of JSON parsing and stringifying functions, including polyfills for Date.prototype.toJSON and other JSON-related methods. It creates a global JSON object with methods 'stringify' and 'parse'.

methods.name: JSON.stringify
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript value to a JSON string, with optional replacer and space parameters.

methods.name: JSON.parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to produce a JavaScript object or array, with optional reviver function.
